item.title: In 1957, Georgia artist Eddie Owens Martin began transforming his inherited farmhouse and seven acres
item.description: Eddie Owens Martin, an innovative and unconventional artist, dedicated nearly three decades to transforming his land in Georgia into the vibrant, visionary art space known as Pasaquan. He intricately combined various cultural elements through his painted totems and impressive masonry. After years of exposure and deterioration, the Kohler Foundation intervened with a major restoration, breathing new life into this unique site. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
